tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

options.text: Gangue is an ore contaminated with undesired materials.
The scientific and technological process used for isolation of the metal from its ore is known as metallurgy.
Minerals are naturally occurring chemical substances in the earth's crust.
Ores are minerals that may contain a metal.

solution.text: Gangue is the commercially worthless material which contaminates the ore.
